'''Rayler''' (Japanese: '''トラヒコ''' ''Torahiko''), known as '''Rayhiko''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translation, is a {{p|Luxray}} that {{adv|Pearl}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. As of ''[[PS437|The Final Dimensional Duel VII]]'', he is at [[level]] 60, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "thoroughly cunning."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
Rayler first appears as a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Luxio}} in ''[[PS340|Extreme Luxio]]'', where he was a member of a pack of {{pkmn2|wild}} Luxio and {{p|Shinx}}. However, his claws were broken and because of it, Luxio could not communicate with his pack members, causing them to shun him. In a desperate attempt to get them to acknowledge him, he kidnapped {{adv|Platinum}} and her {{TP|Platinum|Piplup}} so that he could challenge {{adv|Pearl}} and {{adv|Diamond}}. He first fought Diamond's {{p|Munchlax}}, {{adv|Lax}}, and his {{p|Torterra}}, [[Tru]], easily beating them due to their slow speed. After beating them, his pack still refused to accept him and he began to attack Pearl's team. During his fight against them, Pearl noticed his broken claws and quickly came up with a way for him to communicate with his pack, using his [[wp:Double act|comedy duo]] act as the base. Being able to communicate with his pack again, he thanked the group and left.

He reappeared as a {{p|Luxray}} in ''[[PS349|Passing by Probopass and Maneuvering around Magnezone]]'', where he helped Diamond rescue Pearl and Platinum, after [[Cyrus]] attacked them while they were passing through [[Mount Coronet]] for "defiling" the site of his Pokémon's [[Evolution]]s. He used his X-ray vision to save one of his pack members, a Shinx. He left again with his pack after helping save Pearl and Platinum.
[[File:Rayler X-ray vision.png|thumb|190px|left|Rayler's X-ray vision]]
He returns once again in ''[[PS384|Maddening Magby]]'', where he encountered Pearl at the [[Fuego Ironworks]] on his adventure to protect [[Lake Valor]] from [[Team Galactic]], where he was revealed to have become the leader of the pack. As Pearl was about to enter Luxray dragged him over to a different opening and entered with him, using his X-ray vision to find the trapped [[Mr. Fuego]]. After finding him Pearl accidentally steps on a conveyor belt heading straight to a furnace. Luxray quickly jumps into action and saved Pearl, getting his back burned in the process. Pearl then asks Luxray to carry him to Mr. Fuego due to his ability to see all the conveyor belts, which Luxray accepts. The two are soon spotted by a {{p|Houndoom}} who chases them throughout the building. While fleeing Pearl tells Luxray when to dodge as he focuses on their destination, though he is hit in the process. Once they arrived Luxray turned around and retaliated with {{m|Shock Wave}}, knocking Houndoom out. After leaving he decided to join Pearl on his journey, becoming his third Pokémon.
[[File:Pearl and Rayler.png|thumb|190px|Rayler and Pearl]]

In ''[[PS397|Outwitting Octillery]]'', Rayler worked alongside his team to reach the middle of [[Lake Valor]] in an attempt to find {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf}}. Halfway across the lake, they get attacked by [[Saturn]]'s {{p|Octillery}}, who uses {{m|Octazooka}} to destroy their raft. Saturn shows up on a UFO-like vessel and grabs Pearl, demanding to know why he was heading for the island in the middle of the lake while Rayler, [[Chatler]], and [[Chimler]] desperately try to free him. A few minutes later, the Galactic Bomb goes off, with its target revealed to be Lake Valor. Pearl and Saturn watched as Azelf revealed itself and Saturn and his grunts begin trying to capture it. Pearl and his team attempt to stop them, but they are overwhelmed by the number of opponents and defeated.

In ''[[PS416|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI]]'', Rayler was used alongside the other Pokémon to battle against the [[Legendary Pokémon]], {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}} and {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}}. With the help of Diamond and Pearl's Pokémon and with a combined technique, they were all able to destroy the [[Red Chain]]s controlling them.

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
In ''[[PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV]]'', Pearl intended to use Rayler alongside the rest of his team to fight [[Charon]] and his {{p|Heatran}} but [[Reg]] showed up with {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}}'s appliances, allowing it to defeat him.

==Personality and characteristics==
Rayler is a proud and noble {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and is very dedicated to his pack. He is stoic, serious, focused, and has a high level of commitment, refusing to back out of something he has started. He cares greatly for others and will jump straight into danger without a second thought in order to save someone.
